title: citysample-carla: running Epic's City Sample as a CARLA simulator
description:
Tooling that runs Epic Games' City Sample (Unreal Engine 5.8, both Small_City_LVL and Big_City_LVL) as a CARLA 1.0 driving simulator, and extracts the city's road network as ASAM OpenDRIVE so it can be driven in any CARLA.

Part A exports Epic's ZoneGraph through a small Unreal plugin and converts it to OpenDRIVE across both Small_City_LVL (3,497 roads, 172 junctions, 145 km, 4,672 spawn points) and Big_City_LVL (23,594 roads, 1,236 junctions, 1,197.5 km, 33,590 spawn points), with road-class speed limits, traffic lights, curbside stop signs, yield signs, US MUTCD speed-limit signs, and crosswalks. Part B hosts the City Sample levels directly as a CARLA 1.0 server, fixing collision channels, FastGeoStreaming camera and LiDAR semantic segmentation (enabled by default, 0.2%-0.4% unlabeled with Sky properly labeled), URayTracer and ego-attached ray-cast sensors, measured ZoneGraph pedestrian navmeshes (7,846 and 59,384 pedestrian lanes forming single connected islands), and a Mass ECS traffic and crowd bridge that centers on the hero vehicle and coexists with CARLA's Traffic Manager. Also verified with CARLA 1.0's NVIDIA NuRec (3DGUT / NRE 26.04) photorealistic neural rendering pipeline.

Twelve reproducible CARLA defects found during the work are documented, with eleven filed upstream.

No Epic Games content, and no data derived from it, is included: the tools regenerate everything from the user's own City Sample installation.
